data.name: Aquascape Glue for Securing Moss — 20 غرام
data.description:
Cyanoacrylate glue for securing moss and some aquatic plants to wood and stone, in a 20 غرام package for medium projects.

Apply a small amount to a clean surface, then gently press the plant according to the package instructions. A white color may appear at the glue spot when contacting water, and it diminishes after the plant grows.

Use only if the package confirms its suitability for aquariums after curing, and avoid contact with skin and eyes.

data.name: Black Volcanic Lava Stone
data.description:
Black volcanic lava stone with a porous structure, used as décor or as a porous medium within certain filtration systems.

Rinse thoroughly before use to remove dust. As natural stones may vary between batches, it is not chemically neutral without testing; if the tank is sensitive to pH or GH/KH, monitor readings after addition.

Ensure the pieces are stable and free of sharp edges that could harm fish.
